subject.title: control-ui: expose reply-to metadata to agent sessions and avoid confusing no-output completion notices

question: Should this combined issue remain open as the umbrella for structured reply metadata plus no-output terminal-state semantics, or should maintainers split it between the reply-metadata PR and the final-fallback contract issue?
rationale: The remaining work crosses Control UI protocol, agent runtime context, channel reply semantics, and final fallback delivery policy, so automation should not choose the permanent contract or tracker shape.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
options.body: Keep this issue open while the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback delivery policy are reviewed and landed or explicitly rejected.

options.title: Split To Canonical Items
options.body: Close this only after maintainers confirm https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90745 or https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/88032 fully owns reply metadata and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561 fully owns no-output semantics.

options.title: Narrow To Reply Metadata
options.body: Retitle or scope this issue to Control UI structured reply metadata only and leave final-fallback/no-output delivery entirely to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/87561.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Until Contracts Land
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while the structured reply metadata path and durable final-fallback delivery policy are reviewed and landed or explicitly rejected.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already routed in the issue timeline and has feature-history context in the affected prompt-prelude boundary, making him the best available product-direction owner from this evidence.
